answer.reason: The verses tell of Amaziah's victory over Edom, his defeat by Israel's king, and his death by conspiracy, beyond the summary's relation and office.

clauses.english: defeated ten thousand of the children of Seir in the valley of salt
clauses.quote: smote of the children of Seir ten thousand

clauses.english: was taken captive by Jehoash of Israel at Bethshemesh, and Jerusalem's wall was broken down
clauses.quote: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah

clauses.english: fled to Lachish after a conspiracy in Jerusalem and was slain there
clauses.quote: they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there

doubts: 2KI 14:7 and 2CH 25:12 on Edom were not marked, so only the marked 2CH 25:11 is cited for the victory.
Marked verses 2KI 13:12, 2KI 14:15, 2KI 14:21, 2KI 15:1, 2KI 15:3 and 2CH 26:1 mention him only in passing, and 1CH 3:12 only in a genealogy.
2KI 14:19 is not marked but states the conspiracy and death, and 2CH 25:27 is the marked parallel.
